description: Provision a Google Cloud Iam IAMAccessBoundaryPolicy via Config Connector. Fields mirror the iam.cnrm.cloud.google.com/v1beta1 IAMAccessBoundaryPolicy spec.

displayName.description: The display name of the rule.

projectId.description: GCP project ID for this resource. Rendered as the cnrm.cloud.google.com/project-id annotation. Leave empty to inherit the project from the namespace (Config Connector falls back to the namespace's project-id annotation, then to the namespace name). Leave empty when this resource's spec already carries a projectRef.
projectId.title: GCP project ID

projectRef.description: Set exactly one of `external` (the resource's GCP URI or ID) or `name` (plus optional `namespace`) referencing another Config Connector resource in the cluster.

external.description: Allowed value: string of the format `cloudresourcemanager.googleapis.com%2Fprojects%2F{{value}}`, where {{value}} is the `name` field of a `Project` resource.

name.description: Name of the referent. More info: https://kubernetes.io/docs/concepts/overview/working-with-objects/names/#names

namespace.description: Namespace of the referent. More info: https://kubernetes.io/docs/concepts/overview/working-with-objects/namespaces/

resourceID.description: Immutable. Optional. The name of the resource. Used for creation and acquisition. When unset, the value of `metadata.name` is used as the default.

accessBoundaryRule.description: An access boundary rule in an IAM policy.

availabilityCondition.description: The availability condition further constrains the access allowed by the access boundary rule.

description.description:
Description of the expression. This is a longer text which describes the expression,
e.g. when hovered over it in a UI.

expression.description: Textual representation of an expression in Common Expression Language syntax.

location.description:
String indicating the location of the expression for error reporting,
e.g. a file name and a position in the file.

title.description:
Title for the expression, i.e. a short string describing its purpose.
This can be used e.g. in UIs which allow to enter the expression.

availablePermissions.description: A list of permissions that may be allowed for use on the specified resource.

availableResource.description: The full resource name of a Google Cloud resource entity.

title: GCP Iam IAMAccessBoundaryPolicy
